sections.title: Player text
sections.body: It all comes at once: the dead clawing up faster, the wraiths pressing in, the Custodian's glow guttering like a candle in wind. The clock is close, but so is disaster. Every choice now costs something: guard her and leave a friend exposed, or save the friend and let her take the hit that sets you all back. There is no clean way through. There is only what you are willing to give.

sections.title: Public objective
sections.body: Survive the peak and drive the countdown home.

Gmgoal: Run the peak HOLD/BREAK choice and let resource spends, protection, and sacrifice decide the outcome track.
Publicobjective: Survive the peak and drive the countdown home.

Readaloud: It all comes at once: the dead clawing up faster, the wraiths pressing in, the Custodian's glow guttering like a candle in wind. The clock is close, but so is disaster. Every choice now costs something: guard her and leave a friend exposed, or save the friend and let her take the hit that sets you all back. There is no clean way through. There is only what you are willing to give.
Gmnotes: No PC is required to land the final blow. Let any meaningful action create the final tick if fiction supports it.
Gmscript: Say: "All-in time. Spend Hope, boons, big abilities, tag-team moments, and last good ideas. You cannot cover it all, so what you choose to save becomes the ending."
Gmreadaloud: It all comes at once. The Custodian's glow gutters like a candle in wind. The clock is close, but so is disaster.

Gmchecklist: Threaten the Custodian honestly. Offer Death Move choices heroically if a PC marks their last HP: Blaze of Glory, Avoid Death, or Risk It All. Use HOLD if she is protected and the party drives the countdown home cleanly. Use BREAK if someone falls, she is hit badly, or the win is bought with a severe cost. Seed ritual_outcome as clean, costly, or pyrrhic; finalize protected_whom.
Gmprivate: Custodian death remains a Kyle canon flag. Use dying only as a marked unresolved possibility unless ruled live.
Playertakeaway: This is the moment you will remember: give everything, choose who you save, and finish it.
Storytakeaway: You cannot save everything, so what you choose to save becomes the ending.
Mechanictakeaway: Peak play spends Hope, boons, tag-team actions, Death Moves, and final countdown ticks to write ritual_outcome and protected_whom.

Every act offers at least one guaranteed and one earned hint that the danger is manufactured and the forest is not the enemy.
